title: NepTTS-Bench finds rare extreme Whisper errors can distort average Nepali speech scores
summary: Version 1 reports extreme Whisper transcription errors on a minority of generated files that distorted average automated scores; listener rankings are not presented as one universal winner. The result is specific to the evaluated Nepali speech systems and test set; it does not establish a universal ranking of text-to-speech systems.
ai_technology: Whisper transcriptions and the NepaliMOS model were evaluated alongside native-speaker judgments for Nepali text-to-speech outputs.
organization: Ampixa Labs; Kathmandu University; Tribhuvan University
